hero.title:
One car listing.
Twelve filters.
hero.lead: OKazCar analyses car listings from leboncoin, La Centrale, ParuVendu and AutoScout24 across 11 countries in real time. Score out of 100, geolocated market price, anomaly detection — directly in your browser.

showcase.title:
The OKazCar panel,
injected into the listing.
showcase.lead: When you open a listing on one of the 14 supported platforms, the extension detects the vehicle, triggers the analysis pipeline, and displays a side panel with the verdict in seconds.
showcase.h01_desc: DOM parsed, critical fields (price, km, year, make, engine) captured. If extraction is incomplete, the pipeline stops — no dubious score.
showcase.h02_desc: Multi-strategy search: geolocation (30km radius), regional expansion, national market. Median by power range.
showcase.h03_desc: Score out of 100 = weighted sum of 12 filters. Each filter contributes according to its criticality. Filters tied to market data and vehicle coherence carry the most weight.

filters.title:
12 filters.
16 weight points.
Zero blind spots.
filters.lead_pre: Each filter checks one dimension of the vehicle or the listing, with a weight according to its criticality.

steps.d: Add OKazCar from the Chrome Web Store. No account, no excessive permissions — only the domains of supported platforms.
When the listing loads, the extension detects the platform (LBC, LC, PV, AS24), parses the DOM and extracts critical fields.
12 filters run in parallel (max 11 workers): reference database, geolocated market price, statistics, seller, import, engine reliability.
Weighted score out of 100 displayed in an injected panel. Filter-by-filter details, sources, recommendations.

items.d: Avoid scams, identify good deals, negotiate with objective data.
Set the right price before publishing. Compare your listing against local competition.
Accelerated sourcing, competitor stock audit, alerts on unaddressed manufacturer recalls.

blog.title:
The method
behind the score.
blog.lead: Technical articles on anomaly detection, the used car market, engine reliability. No bullshit, no keyword stuffing, just the facts.

items.a: Yes, 100% free. No account, no subscription, no personal data collected. The extension runs entirely locally in your browser.

4 platforms and 15 domains: leboncoin.fr, lacentrale.fr, paruvendu.fr, and AutoScout24 across 11 countries (France, Germany, Switzerland, Belgium, Italy, Netherlands, Austria, Spain, Poland, Luxembourg, Sweden) + the international .com.

12 filters analyse the listing in parallel. Each filter carries a weight based on how critical it is — the most decisive ones (data coherence, price positioning) count more. The final score is a weighted average rounded to 100.
No. The extension only analyses the listing you are viewing. No personal data is stored or transmitted to a third-party server.
Currently, OKazCar is available on Google Chrome and Chromium-compatible browsers (Brave, Edge, Opera, Arc).

items.q: How is the market price calculated?
items.a: OKazCar compares the listed price against recent similar listings in the same geographic area. Make, engine type and power output are taken into account to ensure the comparison is relevant. If the local sample is too small, the analysis automatically widens its scope.
